notes: Consumers must skip entries with change_type 'removed': the clause is kept in the PDF as a deletion notice only, with status NotApplicable, and requires no answer. Refs are renumbered where the addendum inserts a clause; compare with pack A by position, not by ref.

requirements.text: This specification applies to all parts for the Volt-7 electric platform that Acme Components is invited to quote under RFQ AM-2026-0417, covering the six part families listed in section 2.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components quotes all six catalog families HSG, FST, SNS, CON, BRK and HRN.

requirements.text: In this document Buyer means Arvant Motors, Supplier means Acme Components, and Part means any item supplied to a Buyer drawing, specification or purchase order issued under this RFQ.
requirements.rationale: Definitions carry no technical or commercial commitment.

requirements.text: Where documents conflict, the Buyer drawing prevails over this specification, and this specification prevails over any referenced Buyer standard.
requirements.rationale: Order of precedence accepted; no catalog limit applies.

requirements.text: The Supplier quotation shall remain valid for 180 calendar days from the response due date and shall be submitted in English.
requirements.rationale: No catalog limit on quotation validity.

requirements.text: Start of production is now planned for November 2027; the Supplier shall confirm that tooling and capacity can support this date.
requirements.rationale: Tooling 16 weeks plus series 6 weeks fits a November 2027 start.

requirements.text: Aluminium die-cast housings for the EV motor and inverter shall operate continuously from -40 C to +150 C without loss of function.
requirements.rationale: HSG operating temperature -40 to +150 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: Housing castings shall achieve a tensile strength of at least 240 MPa measured on cast-to-shape test bars.
requirements.rationale: HSG tensile 240 MPa min meets 240 MPa.

requirements.text: Housings shall withstand 1000 h of neutral salt spray with no corrosion penetrating the coating.
requirements.rationale: HSG salt spray is 720 h; 1000 h cannot be met.

requirements.text: Sealed housings shall meet ingress protection IP6K9K in the fully assembled condition.
requirements.rationale: HSG ingress IP6K9K meets the contract.

requirements.text: The sealing face of each housing shall be flat within 0.15 mm.
requirements.rationale: HSG flatness 0.15 mm meets the contract.

requirements.text: Housings shall pass the thermal shock sequence defined in the Buyer test plan, which will be issued after nomination.
requirements.rationale: Test plan not yet issued; the sequence needs Buyer input.

requirements.text: Housings shall be 100 percent leak tested with helium before shipment.
requirements.rationale: Leak testing is done, but on a sampling plan and not on every housing.

requirements.text: Class 10.9 forged steel fasteners shall have a tensile strength of at least 1040 MPa.
requirements.rationale: FST tensile 1040 MPa min meets the contract.

requirements.text: Fasteners shall carry a zinc-nickel coating applied to the Buyer coating specification.
requirements.rationale: FST zinc-nickel coating is the catalog coating.

requirements.text: Coated fasteners shall withstand 480 h of salt spray to red rust.
requirements.rationale: FST salt spray 480 h to red rust meets 480 h.

requirements.text: Fasteners shall retain their rated properties from -40 C to +200 C.
requirements.rationale: FST operating temperature -40 to +200 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: PA66-GF30 sensor housings shall operate from -40 C to +125 C.
requirements.rationale: SNS operating temperature -40 to +125 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: Sensor housings shall meet ingress protection IP67.
requirements.rationale: SNS ingress IP67 meets the contract.

requirements.text: Metallic inserts and coated surfaces of sensor housings shall withstand 240 h of salt spray.
requirements.rationale: SNS salt spray 240 h meets 240 h.

requirements.text: Terminal and connector assemblies shall operate from -40 C to +125 C.
requirements.rationale: CON operating temperature -40 to +125 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: Connector assemblies shall meet ingress protection IP69K when mated.
requirements.rationale: CON ingress is IP67, not IP69K.

requirements.text: Connector assemblies shall carry a rated current of 30 A continuously.
requirements.rationale: CON rated current 30 A meets the contract.

requirements.text: Connector assemblies shall withstand 10000 cycles of mating and unmating without loss of contact performance.
requirements.rationale: CON 10000 mating cycles meets the contract.

requirements.text: High-current connector variants for the traction inverter shall be rated at 40 A in addition to the standard 30 A variant.
requirements.rationale: Standard 30 A is catalog; a 40 A variant is not in the contract.

requirements.text: Ductile iron brake caliper brackets shall achieve a tensile strength of at least 500 MPa.
requirements.rationale: BRK tensile 500 MPa min meets the contract.

requirements.text: Brackets shall withstand 480 h of salt spray.
requirements.rationale: BRK salt spray 480 h meets 480 h.

requirements.text: Brackets shall operate from -40 C to +180 C.
requirements.rationale: BRK operating temperature -40 to +180 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall provide fatigue life data for brackets to the Buyer load spectrum.
requirements.rationale: Tensile data exists; fatigue data to the Buyer spectrum needs new testing.

requirements.text: Wiring harness sub-assemblies shall operate from -40 C to +105 C.
requirements.rationale: HRN operating temperature -40 to +105 C meets the contract.

requirements.text: Harness connectors shall meet ingress protection IP67 at the connector.
requirements.rationale: HRN ingress IP67 at connector meets the contract.

requirements.text: Every harness sub-assembly shall pass a 100 percent end-of-line electrical test before shipment.
requirements.rationale: HRN 100 percent end-of-line electrical test meets the contract.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall submit a material data sheet through the IMDS system for every Part before first sample submission.
requirements.rationale: Material declarations are part of standard PPAP practice.

requirements.text: All Parts shall comply with the REACH and RoHS regulations and the Supplier shall provide a written declaration with each PPAP submission.
requirements.rationale: Catalog materials are declared as REACH and RoHS compliant; the declaration can accompany PPAP.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall maintain an environmental management system certified to ISO 14001 at every producing site.
requirements.rationale: ISO 14001 is held at Pune and Brno.

requirements.text: Parts shall comply with the Buyer restricted substances list, which is revised twice a year; the applicable revision will be confirmed after nomination.
requirements.rationale: The applicable list revision is not stated and needs Buyer input.

requirements.text: Packaging materials shall be recyclable and free of single-use plastics where technically feasible.
requirements.rationale: Standard Acme Components packaging is recyclable.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall hold a valid IATF 16949 certificate covering every site that produces Parts under this RFQ.
requirements.rationale: IATF 16949 is held at Pune and Brno.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall hold a valid ISO 9001 certificate for all producing sites.
requirements.rationale: ISO 9001 is held.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall hold a valid ISO 45001 certificate for occupational health and safety at all producing sites.
requirements.rationale: ISO 45001 is held.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall hold a valid TISAX assessment label at assessment level AL2 for information security.
requirements.rationale: TISAX AL2 is held.

requirements.text: Production part approval shall be submitted at PPAP level 3 unless the Buyer agrees a lower level for carry-over parts.
requirements.rationale: PPAP levels 1-3 are supported.

requirements.text: Delivered quality shall be below 50 PPM, measured monthly per part number.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components PPM under 50 meets the contract.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall respond to a quality complaint with an interim containment report within 24 hours and a complete 8D report within 10 working days.
requirements.rationale: 8D within 10 working days meets the contract; interim containment is standard.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall submit a control plan and a process FMEA for each Part with the PPAP package.
requirements.rationale: Control plan and PFMEA are standard PPAP items.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall hold a valid TISAX assessment label at assessment level AL3 before the nomination decision.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components holds TISAX AL2 only.

requirements.text: The tooling lead time from tooling order to first sample shall not exceed 14 weeks.
requirements.rationale: Tooling lead time is 16 weeks; 14 weeks cannot be met.

requirements.text: The series lead time from release to delivery shall not exceed 6 weeks from receipt of a firm order.
requirements.rationale: Series lead time 6 weeks meets the contract.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall deliver under Incoterms 2020 FCA at the named Supplier site.
requirements.rationale: FCA is supported.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall also quote delivery under Incoterms 2020 DAP at the Buyer assembly plant.
requirements.rationale: DAP is supported.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall exchange delivery schedules and despatch advices with the Buyer through EDIFACT EDI messages.
requirements.rationale: EDI via EDIFACT is supported.

requirements.text: In addition to EDIFACT messages, the Supplier shall send the advance shipping notice through the Buyer web API.
requirements.rationale: EDIFACT is supported; a Buyer web API integration is not in the catalog.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall submit a packaging proposal for Buyer approval before the first series delivery.
requirements.rationale: A packaging proposal is a standard deliverable.

requirements.text: Deleted by Addendum 1.
requirements.rationale: Clause deleted by Addendum 1; nothing to answer. Consumers skip removed clauses.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall report on-time delivery weekly through the Buyer supplier portal.
requirements.rationale: Weekly delivery reporting is feasible.

requirements.text: The Supplier accepts liquidated damages for late delivery of up to 5 percent of the value of the affected purchase order.
requirements.rationale: Liquidated damages accepted up to 5 percent of affected PO value.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall grant an annual price reduction of 3 percent for 3 years from start of production.
requirements.rationale: Annual price-down is limited to 2 percent for 3 years; 3 percent is an exception.

requirements.text: Payment shall be made 75 days net from the date of a correct invoice.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components payment terms are net 60; net 75 is a commercial exception.

requirements.text: The Supplier warrants Parts against defects for 36 months or 100000 km, whichever comes first, including the cost of removal and reinstallation at the vehicle assembly plant.
requirements.rationale: Warranty term meets the contract; removal and reinstallation cost is not accepted.

requirements.text: Supplier liability under this RFQ is limited to direct damages caused by a defective Part.
requirements.rationale: Direct-damage liability is acceptable.

requirements.text: Tooling paid for by the Buyer remains the property of the Buyer and shall be marked as such.
requirements.rationale: Buyer-paid tooling ownership is standard practice.

requirements.text: Each party retains ownership of its background intellectual property; no licence is granted except as needed to supply Parts.
requirements.rationale: Background IP stays with each party.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall accept the Buyer Supplier Code of Conduct in its current version.
requirements.rationale: Code of conduct is acceptable.

requirements.text: The Buyer may audit the Supplier and its sub-suppliers on 10 working days notice.
requirements.rationale: Audit rights on notice are acceptable.

requirements.text: Prices shall be quoted in euro per piece, fixed for the first twelve months of series production, and shall exclude tooling.
requirements.rationale: Fixed piece pricing is within commercial limits.

requirements.text: Prices include packaging and the delivery obligation of the agreed Incoterm and exclude value added tax.
requirements.rationale: Standard price composition.

requirements.text: Payment shall be made 75 days net from the date of a correct invoice.
requirements.rationale: Acme Components payment terms are net 60; net 75 is a commercial exception.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall grant an annual price reduction of 3 percent on all series prices for 3 years from start of production.
requirements.rationale: Annual price-down is limited to 2 percent for 3 years; 3 percent is an exception.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall pay liquidated damages for late delivery of up to 5 percent of the value of the affected purchase order.
requirements.rationale: Liquidated damages accepted up to 5 percent of affected PO value.

requirements.text: The warranty period is 36 months or 100000 km, whichever comes first, from the date of vehicle build.
requirements.rationale: Warranty 36 months or 100000 km meets the contract.

requirements.text: Each party is liable for direct damages only; indirect and consequential losses are excluded.
requirements.rationale: Direct-damage liability is acceptable.

requirements.text: Tooling paid for by the Buyer is Buyer property; the Supplier maintains it at its own cost and insures it for replacement value.
requirements.rationale: Tooling custody and maintenance are standard practice.

requirements.text: Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information secret for ten years after the end of the supply relationship.
requirements.rationale: A ten-year confidentiality term is acceptable.

requirements.text: This agreement is governed by the law of the Buyer's seat and disputes are decided by arbitration, the seat and rules of which will be named in the purchase order.
requirements.rationale: Seat and rules of arbitration are not stated and need Buyer input.

requirements.text: Neither party is liable for delay caused by force majeure, provided it notifies the other party within five working days.
requirements.rationale: Standard force majeure clause.

requirements.text: The Buyer may terminate a purchase order for convenience on twelve months written notice against payment of finished goods and open material.
requirements.rationale: Termination for convenience with compensation is acceptable.

requirements.text: Neither party may assign this agreement without the written consent of the other party, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
requirements.rationale: Standard assignment clause.

requirements.text: Notices shall be in writing and sent to the contact addresses named in the purchase order.
requirements.rationale: Standard notices clause.

requirements.text: The Supplier shall maintain product liability insurance appropriate to the supply volume throughout the supply relationship.
requirements.rationale: Product liability insurance is held.

requirements.text: Confirm that Acme Components will quote all six part families named in section 2.
requirements.rationale: All six catalog families are quoted.

requirements.text: State the validated continuous operating temperature range of your aluminium die-cast housings.
requirements.rationale: HSG -40 to +150 C is the contract range.

requirements.text: State the minimum tensile strength of your housing castings in MPa.
requirements.rationale: HSG tensile 240 MPa min.

requirements.text: Confirm the neutral salt-spray hours your housings achieve (the Buyer now requires 1000 h).
requirements.rationale: HSG salt spray is 720 h; 1000 h cannot be met.

requirements.text: Confirm the ingress protection rating achieved by your sealed housings.
requirements.rationale: HSG IP6K9K.

requirements.text: Confirm the salt-spray hours your zinc-nickel coated fasteners achieve to red rust.
requirements.rationale: FST 480 h to red rust.

requirements.text: Confirm the ingress protection rating of your PA66-GF30 sensor housings.
requirements.rationale: SNS IP67.

requirements.text: State the rated current and mating-cycle capability of your connector assemblies.
requirements.rationale: CON 30 A and 10000 mating cycles.

requirements.text: State the minimum tensile strength of your ductile iron brackets in MPa.
requirements.rationale: BRK tensile 500 MPa min.

requirements.text: Describe the end-of-line electrical test applied to harness sub-assemblies.
requirements.rationale: HRN 100 percent end-of-line electrical test.

requirements.text: Provide your ISO 14001 certificate number and expiry date for each plant.
requirements.rationale: ISO 14001 is held at both plants.

requirements.text: Provide your IATF 16949 certificate number and expiry date for each plant.
requirements.rationale: IATF 16949 is held at both plants.

requirements.text: Provide your ISO 9001 certificate number and expiry date.
requirements.rationale: ISO 9001 is held.

requirements.text: Do you hold an ISO 45001 certificate? Provide the certificate details.
requirements.rationale: ISO 45001 is held.

requirements.text: Which TISAX assessment level does your current label cover?
requirements.rationale: TISAX AL2 is held.

requirements.text: Which PPAP levels can you support for new and carry-over parts?
requirements.rationale: PPAP levels 1-3 are supported.

requirements.text: State your delivered quality level in PPM over the last twelve months.
requirements.rationale: PPM under 50.

requirements.text: Confirm the Incoterms 2020 rules you support for series delivery.
requirements.rationale: FCA and DAP are supported.

requirements.text: Confirm that you can exchange EDI messages in EDIFACT format.
requirements.rationale: EDI via EDIFACT.

requirements.text: Confirm acceptance of liquidated damages for late delivery as set out in the commercial terms.
requirements.rationale: Liquidated damages accepted up to 5 percent.

requirements.text: Confirm acceptance of the annual price reduction in section 6 (now 3 percent for 3 years).
requirements.rationale: Annual price-down is limited to 2 percent for 3 years; 3 percent is an exception.

requirements.text: Confirm that your liability is limited to direct damages.
requirements.rationale: Direct-damage liability is acceptable.

requirements.text: Confirm acceptance of the Buyer Supplier Code of Conduct.
requirements.rationale: Code of conduct is acceptable.

requirements.text: List the plants from which the Parts would be supplied.
requirements.rationale: Plants are Pune IN and Brno CZ.

requirements.text: Name your sales and quality contacts for this RFQ.
requirements.rationale: Administrative response.

requirements.text: Confirm that all prices are quoted in euro per piece.
requirements.rationale: Fixed piece pricing is within commercial limits.
